correctness.rationale: All four incidence cases follow from explicit convolution representation functions N-2C+D and a six-entry character-sum table, with the standard quadratic-character identity valid over every odd finite field. The full proof accounts for repeated intersection points in tangent and secant cases and checks q=3 boundaries. Independent direct sum-counting in checker.py passed 236 line configurations including F9, F25 and F49. The finite calculations verify examples, while the symbolic character proof establishes all q.

value.rationale: Joining one affine line to the complete parabola is the first natural nontransitive mixed curved/flat support beyond the homogeneous parabola. The complete fourth-moment classification separates vertical from tangent lines despite equal intersection cardinality and has a genuine quadratic-character dependence in tangent and secant cases. It yields exact sharp Linfinity-to-L4 extension constants and exposes how directional incidence controls additive quadruple multiplicities. The object and energy are canonical rather than a hand-picked finite slice.
